note_en: Observed by InfraOne from its own production calls (free tiers; where we use several keys separated by purpose for one provider, they are combined per provider; we do not pool keys to raise free limits); no extra requests were made. Until 2026-10-01 our side paused a provider for hours after a limit, so there are no observations during those pauses.
